body:
**Location:** Essex
**Job Type:** Full-Time, Permanent
**Start Date:** ASAP

### About the Role

Bright Futures Recruitment is recruiting an experienced and passionate Creative Psychotherapist to join a specialist SEMH school in Essex.

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified therapist who is passionate about supporting children and young people with social, emotional and mental health needs, trauma and additional learning difficulties.

You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team, providing therapeutic interventions that support pupils' emotional wellbeing, personal development and engagement in education.

### Key Responsibilities

* Deliver individual and group creative psychotherapy sessions tailored to pupils' needs.
* Use creative therapeutic approaches, including art, drama, music or play therapy, depending on your specialism.
* Support children and young people who have experienced trauma, emotional difficulties and behavioural challenges.
* Work closely with teaching staff, SENCOs and other professionals to develop therapeutic support plans.
* Maintain accurate records, assessments and progress reports.
* Contribute to a positive, nurturing and therapeutic school environment.
* Follow safeguarding policies and promote the welfare of all pupils.

### About You

We are looking for a confident, compassionate and professional individual who can build positive relationships with vulnerable young people.

The ideal candidate will have:

* A recognised qualification in Creative Psychotherapy, Art Therapy, Dramatherapy, Music Therapy or a relevant therapeutic discipline.
* Appropriate professional registration, including HCPC registration where required.
* Experience supporting children or young people with SEMH needs, trauma or additional needs.
* An understanding of therapeutic approaches and trauma-informed practice.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a school environment.
* A genuine passion for improving outcomes for vulnerable young people.

Previous experience within a specialist school, alternative provision or SEND setting would be advantageous.

### Why Apply?

* Opportunity to make a meaningful difference to young people's lives.
* Supportive and collaborative multidisciplinary team.
* Specialist educational environment with a strong therapeutic focus.
* Opportunity to develop your experience within SEMH education.
* Permanent position offering stability and professional development.

### Apply Today

If you are a qualified Creative Psychotherapist looking for a rewarding position within a specialist educational setting, we would love to hear from you.
summary: Bright Futures Recruitment is seeking a qualified Creative Psychotherapist to join a specialist SEMH school in Essex on a full-time, permanent basis. The successful candidate will provide individual and group therapeutic interventions, supporting children and young people with emotional, behavioural and trauma-related needs. This is a rewarding opportunity to work within a supportive multidisciplinary team and make a real difference to young people's wellbeing and development. Immediate start available.
title: Creative Psychotherapist
